items.title: Aloft and Conan Exiles Enhanced Launch on PS5 in Early 2027
items.summary: Funcom 喺 PlayStation Blog 宣布合作沙盒《Aloft》同《Conan Exiles Enhanced》將喺 2027 年初登陸 PS5；《Aloft》會帶齊 Early Access 更新同 1.0 內容，而擁有 PS4 版《Conan Exiles》嘅玩家可免費升級 Enhanced，DLC 亦可繼承。
items.note: article:published_time 2026-10-27T09:00:43-07:00 → HKT. Exact calendar dates TBA. og:image path year segment looks odd but is the page's official og:image.
items.imageAlt: Aloft and Conan Exiles Enhanced PlayStation Blog hero

items.title: Where Winds Meet Hutuo Battlefield Narrative Arc Revealed, Out November 13
items.summary: 《燕雲十六聲／Where Winds Meet》喺 PS Blog 公開最大敘事章節「滹沱」戰場區域，11 月 13 日隨全球一週年更新上線；PS5／PS5 Pro 會加強 PSSR、光追反射同 DualSense 觸感，並預告袁和平指導嘅雙槍武學稍後登場。
items.note: article:published_time 2026-10-27T08:01:34-07:00 → HKT. Multiplat live-service; PS Blog angles PS5 enhancements.
items.imageAlt: Where Winds Meet Hutuo Battlefield promotional art

items.title: Terrible Lizards Dev Discusses Dinomania Horror Parkour, Out October 29
items.summary: WDR Studios 喺 PS Blog 介紹 90 年代恐龍路邊景點題材恐怖跑酷《Terrible Lizards》，強調第一身平台動作同恐懼節奏；遊戲定於 10 月 29 日推出，並已列入 Xbox Game Pass 同期加入名單。
items.note: article:published_time 2026-10-27T07:00:38-07:00 → HKT. Also day-one Game Pass per Xbox Wire wave 2 (Oct 20).
items.imageAlt: Terrible Lizards PlayStation Blog promotional image

items.title: Xbox Cracks Down on Shovelware Triple-Stack Achievement Games
items.summary: TrueAchievements 取得 Xbox 發給開發者嘅電郵：往後發行「沒有明顯差異體驗」嘅相同遊戲分別掛成就將違反商店政策；若要多平台發行需用 Xbox Play Anywhere 或 game binding 綁定進度同成就，以打擊三連堆疊刷 Gamerscore。
items.note: datePublished 2026-10-27T13:36:16 treated as UTC → HKT. Also covered by Pure Xbox.
items.imageAlt: TrueAchievements report on Xbox triple-stack achievement crackdown

items.title: Hacker Awarded $50k Bounty for Reporting PS5 Linux Hypervisor Bug
items.summary: Tom's Hardware／IGN 報道化名 Jordy 嘅研究員因向 Sony 回報可用於喺 PS5 載入 Linux 嘅 hypervisor 漏洞獲 5 萬美元獎金；Sony 已喺 10 月 21 日韌體 14.20 修補，引發部分破解社群反彈。
items.note: published 2026-10-27T13:22:04Z → HKT. Distinct angle from prior jailbreak-criticism coverage already in dedupe.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation 5 console photo for Linux bounty story

items.title: Final 3 PS Plus Extra Games for October 2026 Available to Download Now
items.summary: Push Square 報道英國、美國同日本 PS Plus Extra 訂戶今日可下載 10 月 Extra 最後一批：《Poppy Playtime: Chapter 2》、《Tales of Arise: Beyond the Dawn Edition》同《Monster Energy Supercross 25》；11 月 Essential 名單預計 10 月 28 日公布。
items.note: Push Square stamped '9am' on Oct 27; UK already on GMT after Oct 25 clock change → ~17:00 HKT. Other regions got these titles earlier.
items.imageAlt: PS Plus Extra October final games hero image

items.title: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy Launches on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series
items.summary: Stormind Games 生存恐怖三部曲終章《Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy》已喺 PC（Steam／Epic／GOG）、PS5 同 Xbox Series／Cloud 發售，標準版 US$29.99；Nintendo Switch 2 版改期 12 月 3 日。
items.note: Publisher press dated 27/10/2026; no clock time. Distinct from earlier Switch 2 date-move coverage already in dedupe.
items.imageAlt: Remothered Red Nun's Legacy key art

items.title: Original Xbox Games Now Appearing in Xbox Profile Achievement History
items.summary: 多名玩家發現原初 Xbox 遊戲開始出現喺主機個人檔案成就歷史，顯示 0 成就／0G；TrueAchievements 指或為稍後為指定懷舊作加入成就嘅前期跡象，但 Microsoft 尚未正式宣布即時上線。
items.note: datePublished 2026-10-26T12:45:46 treated as UTC → HKT. Speculative/user-spotted; Xbox previously promised select OG titles later in 2026.
items.imageAlt: Original Xbox games appearing in achievement history

items.title: Phantom Blade Zero Review Roundup: 88 on Metacritic Ahead of Launch
items.summary: Output Lag 整理《Phantom Blade Zero》發售前評分：Metacritic 約 88、OpenCritic 約 89–91，評論普遍讚武打同 Boss，劇情評價兩極；PC 表現較穩，PS5 偶有掉幀，Steam Deck 則被指暫時唔建議遊玩。
items.note: Published Oct 26 ~12:39am local (site), updated Oct 27 6:44pm. Distinct from launch-trailer/physical-editions item already in dedupe. Unlock timing cited as Oct 28 evening ET / Oct 29 China.
items.imageAlt: Phantom Blade Zero boss fight screenshot from review roundup

items.title: Pokémon UNITE Service Ends March 23, 2027
items.summary: 官方宣布《Pokémon UNITE》（Switch 同流動版）將於 2027 年 3 月 23 日 00:00 UTC 結束營運，之後無法登入對戰；服務結束前完成 Library 資料下載嘅訓練家仍可瀏覽持有服裝、執照同成就紀錄。
items.note: Support page updated October 27, 2026 14:58 (tz not labeled; treated ~UTC→HKT). Confirmed on pokemonunite.jp Asia news same day. Theme og only → imageUrl null.

items.title: Xbox Game Pass PC Games Running Natively on Android via DroidDeck
items.summary: Windows Central 報道第三方 App DroidDeck 0.6.0 測試版可喺 Android 本機執行部分 Xbox PC Game Pass 遊戲，無需依賴雲端串流；表現視裝置同遊戲而定，例如 Ayn Thor 上《Hollow Knight: Silksong》可過百幀。
items.note: published 2026-10-27T14:17:08Z → HKT. Third-party/community tool in testing, not an official Xbox feature.
items.imageAlt: Xbox Game Pass on Android via DroidDeck story image

items.title: BLEACH Mirrors High Launches October 28 on iOS and Android
items.summary: Bandai Namco 免費《BLEACH Mirrors High》定於 10 月 28 日登陸 iOS／Android：故事設喺千年血戰之後，由久保帶人新設計角色，並以三人小隊卡牌戰鬥同 SOUL DRIVE 連攜為賣點。
items.imageAlt: BLEACH Mirrors High launch date announcement art

items.title: Capcom H1 FY2027 Operating Profit Up 54.5% to ¥60.8 Billion
items.summary: Capcom 公布截至 2026 年 9 月中期業績：營業額 1,208.87 億日圓（+49.0%）、營業利益 607.69 億日圓（+54.5%）；數位內容銷量 3,686 萬套，其中《鬼武者 Way of the Sword》破 170 萬套，日媒另指《Pragmata》達 270 萬套。
items.note: Official English IR dated October 27, 2026. PublishedAt aligned to gamebiz.jp 16:40 JST stamp (~15:40 HKT). Pragmata 2.7M figure from gamebiz Japanese coverage of same release; English PDF highlights Onimusha 1.7M and catalog growth.
items.imageAlt: Capcom half-year earnings coverage image
